reference: frozen sbl-s0.5; cached design results plus new paired engineering timing control

working_model.A: sensing(pilot+x_soft) restricted to final legal support
working_model.zero_support: zero factor; identity detector input; zero covariance trace

transform.lowrank: thin SVD B=U diag(s) Vh; W=I+U diag((1+s^2/sigma_base)^(-1/2)-1) Uh; BP(Wz,WH,sigma_base)

fixed_terminal: same 20 BP iterations, damping0.5, edge threshold1e-4, Gaussian LLR clip20, LDPC50; one terminal decode per full arm
limitations: working covariance is not calibrated posterior: same-data support/soft-data/gain selection and bias/cross terms are omitted
sigma_final already includes residual uncertainty; added pilot covariance can double count
whitening changes the actual thresholded graph; record transformed inputs and graph; lowrank can densify H and fail cost
negative result excludes only these fixed classical working models, not all cancellation correction
numeric: complex128 NumPy preprocessing; unchanged model complex64 and BP complex128; no silent jitter/pseudoinverse/truncation

engineering.schedule: 4 arms x (1 warmup + 4 measured) paired engineering blocks 17..21 at8dB; warmup17
engineering.purpose: integration and cost screening, not final A2 cost gate; count failed attempts
engineering.screen: compare each arm mean and p95 to same-run frozen Bstar, original A2 micro reference explicitly provisional; do not claim final 1.1 gate
engineering.allocation: do not dispatch design until measured cost and remaining campaign budget demonstrate feasible staged continuation; record any expensive control as ineligible without silently changing formula

formal_gate: original A2 same harness mean AND p95<=1.1, <=22GiB, >=1000 timing samples and frozen protocol; not replaced by engineering screening
truth_policy: truth only offline logger; transform does not receive frame, truth, codeword, path geometry, snapshot path or gain truth
fallback: explicit failure or resource exclusion with evidence; no dense truncation, no diagonal collapse to scalar
